from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            if len(cells) == 1:
                y, x = cells[0]
                neighbors = [grid[yy][xx] for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1))
                             if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w]
                counts = Counter(neighbors)
                surrounding, n = counts.most_common(1)[0]
                out[y][x] = surrounding if surrounding != bg and n >= 3 else bg
    return out

from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            if len(cells) == 1:
                y, x = cells[0]
                neighbors = [grid[yy][xx] for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1))
                             if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w]
                counts = Counter(neighbors)
                n = max(counts.values())
                tied = [color for color, count in counts.items() if count == n]
                if bg in tied and any(color != bg for color in tied) and n >= 2:
                    surrounding = next(color for color in tied if color != bg)
                else:
                    surrounding = tied[0]
                out[y][x] = surrounding if n >= 3 or (n >= 2 and bg in tied and surrounding != bg) else bg
    return out
